q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT SALESPERSON.NAME FROM SALESPERSON,COMPANY,ORDERS WHERE SALESPERSON.SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT SALES_ID FROM ORDERS, COMPANY WHERE ORDERS.COM_ID = (SELECT COM_ID FROM COMPANY WHERE NAME = 'RED') GROUP BY SALES_ID ) GROUP BY SALESPERSON.NAME
